remaining_limits: Platform: validated only on Linux x86_64 (WSL2 kernel 6.18, glibc 2.39) with uv 0.10.11 and uv-managed CPython 3.12.13; macOS, Windows and other Python versions are untested.
Cold install: uv's cache was warm, so a recipient's first install needs network access to PyPI and GitHub (git clone of Teichlab/celltypist at fe357564) and was not timed here.

Model downloads: the cases ran on a seeded CELLTYPIST_FOLDER. With an empty cache, built-in models come from celltypist.cog.sanger.ac.uk under celltypist's fixed 30 s timeout (one timeout was seen during stage-3 verification); the remote index and model builds can change.

Exact majority-voting and seeded-training equality depends on the pinned scanpy/igraph/leidenalg/scikit-learn versions, the same n_jobs and similar BLAS behaviour; expect small numerical drift or cluster relabelling on other hardware.
GPU paths are not exposed or tested.
Scope: faithful wrappers for the 5 selected tools; this does not re-validate CellTypist's models or the paper's results.
